fields.title: LocationRisk
fields.description: One flood-risk result per requested location.

location.title: Location
location.description: The resolved location: label, matched community/LGA/state, and coordinates if known.

matchedCommunity.title: Matched community ID
matchedCommunity.description: Which of the known MVP communities this location was matched to, if any.

windows.title: Risk windows
windows.description: Risk level, confidence, peak date and reasons for the 7-day and/or 30-day forecast windows.

recommendedActions.title: Recommended actions
recommendedActions.description: Fixed list of suggested actions for the highest risk level across all windows.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Data sources used to compute this result, with URLs and retrieval timestamps.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.description: Structural caveats about what this result does and doesn't capture (e.g. urban flash flooding isn't modelled).

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Notes about failed, stale, or fallback data sources used for this specific result.

generatedAt.title: Generated at
generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when this result was computed.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Flood risk results, one row per checked location.
